<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/notification_rules"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Return all notification rules.

The Rule list is readable without project access, consistent with
"existence is not access" (Requirement 11.5).

Each rule also carries ``scope_project_id`` and ``scope_workflow_id`` -
what its scope sits in, for the edit form's picker. Derived here, not
stored with the rule.
